lines.t: Light breaks in on my searching soul
Questions in the silence, a love that pulls me home
Hands in the dirt, heart in the fire
Lay myself down, answer my desire
In the shadows still I hear your call
Breathe in the truth, let my guard fall
Teach me how to love the way you do
Show me how to be made new
I wanna walk in your light, obey with all my might
Every command, every word, echoes in the life I serve
Let me abide in you
Let me love like you do
Trumpet in your name, this is my vow
Denying myself, laying it down
Love for the one who wounded me
Mercy like waves pouring endlessly
I lift up my voice, unashamed and true
Speak your words out
Let them break the rules
I give up all I am
Let my heart be torn
Refined by the flames
So love is reborn
Let me be your example
Messenger strong
Defining my purpose
Where I belong
Let me abide in you
You carry love in all I do
Sound the trumpet, shine your light
Make me whole in sacrifice
Carry on
Thank you.
